uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-21696 flips the node to canonical def-B by changing handle() to take one typed ModelRegistryApiRequest (correlation id read from the request). The handlers delegate their business logic to ServiceRegistryDiscovery, which this change does not touch; the handler constructor and the handler_type and handler_category properties are re-derived byte-identical base_ref<->HEAD by the ratchet from git. Equivalence rests on that git-verbatim preservation plus the executed parity tests, not on a broad branch-coverage claim: the scenario pool drives this node's representative handler (get_node) only, and the other handlers are covered by the node's existing unit suite. uncovered_branch_count is coverage.py's missing_branches for the handler module, not a restatement of the percentage: a rerun of the two get_node parity tests on this head measures 21 of 23 statements covered, 2 of 2 branches covered and 0 missing branches, so the recorded 36.0 percent and the count of 0 are separate measurements, and the percentage is the one the waiver covers. The other eight handlers take the same one request model and are checked against the contract's input_model by tests/integration/nodes/test_registry_api_typed_request_handlers_omn21696.py and the node's unit suites.
